name: Save stops on a profile switch
step: Check that a profile page's Save stops when the profile switches
rationale:
Ported from rfsuite #2809: the FC writes a PID or rate profile record into whichever profile
is active when the write arrives. app/page_runtime.lua now asks MSP_STATUS for the active profile
before each write of a page whose profileField is pidProfile or rateProfile, and stops unsent when it
is not the profile the page read (or, without a telemetry profile, the FC's first answer). Each such
write leaves the MSP queue once and is resent only after the check again, so a lost reply's resend
cannot land in a profile selected meanwhile.

The harness drives the real PIDs and Rates pages through the real page_runtime and codecs against a
mocked FC with one record per profile, and pins the request order, a switch the telemetry has not
shown, telemetry showing the switch, a lost reply with and without a switch, bounded resends, a failed
status request, no telemetry profile, and that a profileField "none" page is not checked.
